# Yuitility

> 167 free browser tools for calculations, documents, images and text. File tools process inputs locally. The optional AI assistant sends messages through the site server to its selected provider; the contact form also uses a server. Hosting requests and optional model downloads require a network connection. See each tool for supported formats, assumptions and limits.

## Site resources
- [Tool directory](https://www.yuitility.app/tools)
